plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Aucun écran déclaré. Une carte flashée m: No screen declared yet. A flashed but undeclared board shows its own MAC address: copy it into a new plugin device to enrol it.

plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Choisir la commande qui allume: Pick the command that turns on
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Choisir la commande qui éteint: Pick the command that turns off
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Secours seulement : le plugin choisit no: Fallback only: the plugin normally picks "Turn on" or "Turn off" from the state, because an out-of-sync "toggle" command inverts the state shown on the screen. It is only used when the state becomes unreadable.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Le plugin lit l'état, puis joue la comma: The plugin reads the state, then plays the opposite command: one press turns on, the next turns off.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Une commande d'action ou un scénario, jo: An action command or a scenario, played as is on every press. For a pulse relay, a gate, a scene.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Obligatoire : sans état, rien ne permet: Required: without a state, nothing decides whether to turn on or off. Saving is refused.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Facultatif. Laissé vide, le plugin repre: Optional. Left empty, the plugin reuses the state Jeedom already links to the action command.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Nom d'icône que le firmware saura dessin: Icon name the firmware knows how to draw: bulb, movie, fan... Free text in v1.
